map.训练算力需求是做什么的？: What does Training Compute Estimator do?
map.如何使用训练算力需求？: How do I use Training Compute Estimator?
map.训练算力需求适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Training Compute Estimator best for?
map.用 Kaplan 缩放律估算训练总算力。: Estimate total training compute with Kaplan scaling laws.
map.训练 FLOPs ≈ 6·N·D（N 为参数量，D 为训练 token 数）；训: Training FLOPs ~ 6 x N x D (N = parameters, D = training tokens); training months ~ 6ND / (GPU count x per-GPU compute x 3600 x 24 x 30)
map.Transformer 训练的经验法则：前向 2N、反向约 4N，合计每 tok: The empirical rule for Transformer training: forward 2N, backward about 4N, total about 6N FLOPs per token, the basis of the Chinchilla-family scaling laws. Divide by the cluster effective compute (must multiply MFU, usually 30%-50% in practice) to get the training period.
map.C ≈ 6·N·D（Kaplan 估算）: C ~ 6 x N x D (Kaplan estimate)
map.N、D 单位需一致，结果数量级参考。: N and D must use consistent units; the result is an order-of-magnitude reference.
map.Kaplan 缩放律：训练 FLOPs≈6·N·D，N 为参数量、D 为训练 t: Kaplan scaling law: training FLOPs ~ 6 x N x D, where N is parameters and D is training tokens.
map.前向约 2ND、反向约 4ND，合计 6ND；用于大模型算力与时间表规划。: Forward about 2ND, backward about 4ND, total 6ND; used for large-model compute and timeline planning.
map.实际受并行效率、通信与显存限制，理论值需乘开销系数。: In practice limited by parallel efficiency, communication and memory; multiply the theoretical value by an overhead factor.
map.N=7×10⁹, D=1×10¹² → FLOPs≈6×7e9×1e12=4.2: N=7x10^9, D=1x10^12 -> FLOPs ~ 6 x 7e9 x 1e12 = 4.2x10^22. At 1e15 FLOPs/s (about 1 effective PFLOPS) it needs ~ 4.2e7 seconds ~ 487 days on a single GPU; in practice a thousand-GPU cluster parallelizes to shorten this.
map.6ND 是上限还是典型值？: Is 6ND an upper bound or a typical value?
map.6ND 是前向+反向的理论下界(理想乘加计数)，实际含激活重算、通信与低效会更高: 6ND is the theoretical lower bound of forward+backward (ideal multiply-add count); in practice activation recompute, communication and inefficiency raise it; for planning, multiply by a 1.5-3x margin to be safe.
map.参数量和训练数据哪个更耗算力？: Which consumes more compute, parameters or training data?
map.二者线性相乘，等比例增。但现代训练常'数据受限'，即数据量不足以让参数充分训练，: They multiply linearly and scale proportionally. But modern training is often 'data-limited', meaning data is insufficient to train parameters fully, so adding data is more cost-effective than adding parameters (until the Chinchilla optimum).
